arStrings.szText: "Who do you think could have done this?"
That’s Darrion, one of the jewelers who buys the ore we dig up. Someone around here must have had a bone to pick with him.

There’s a miner named Korax I’ve been keeping an eye on. Went from bragging about his new dig to avoiding everyone, all within a few days…and wouldn’t you know it, he hasn’t been seen since this morning, when I found Darrion like this.
I need this handled quickly and quietly. Fool's Quarry already has a reputation as a rough town. Last thing we need is traveling merchants deciding we’re not worth the trouble.
If you can bring Korax to me, or at least make sure he can't do this again, there's a nice payday in it for you. What do you say?
